name: Adding a resident to an occupied unit warns and saves nothing
title: SC-02-03-02 Adding a resident to an occupied unit warns and saves nothing
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given unit A Blok D:14 already has an owner
When the manager fills the form for unit "14" and saves
Then a confirmation warning is shown
And cancelling saves nothing
